create_uniform_distribution: create a Uniform distribution with custom low and high bounds using distrax
sample_from_uniform: sample random values from a Uniform distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob_uniform: compute the log probability of a value under a Uniform distribution
calculate_entropy_uniform: calculate the entropy of a Uniform distribution given its low and high bounds
compute_kl_divergence_uniform: compute the KL divergence between two Uniform distributions using the registered TFP function
